title: Ordinary completed-ring compactification composition
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E/Q_ell. Supply operations o and normalized Realizations r, and use the independently constructed completedShriekIntegralA of [lem-sf-completed-shriek-composition-laws]. For a compatible compactification triangle t with the three required quasi-compact opens, define ordinaryComparison on the published integral constructible compact-support functors [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] by the inverse realization for g, the ordinary word for g applied to the inverse realization for f, completedShriekIntegralA, and the realization for gf. This is a natural transformation by construction. No constant-word comparison or choice of an unspecified realization enters it. The old ordinary compositor is reused verbatim, not redefined.
